Nah... it's pretty easy to make my avatar. Just make a gradient (or use the current ones), Color Halftone it (which you can find in the Filters then Pixelate), and then extrude it (also in the Filters and the stylize), then put the sprite in. It is pretty straight forward and looks pretty 1337 . If you want make a border make a new layer by selecting the image, right click and select stroke, and use 2px. But if you want to make an extra 1337 avatar, I have no idea So maybe ask image gurus like usaswim, CTB and BWD.
OF course, if you haven't got photoshop, it makes things more difficult...
